verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers AgentOS and card/expense/bills APIs that could feed AI-driven reconciliation and expense-sync workflows, and webhooks/CLI enable automation, but there's no evidence of a purpose-built 'close the books faster' automation or direct accounting-integration/reconciliation AI feature. missing for 10: explicit month-end close automation, native accounting-system (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite) sync evidence, and independent proof of AI-driven reconciliation reducing close time.
